correctness.rationale: PASS: Stationary partial Fourier equations for the two-state linear switched diffusion yield f0=alpha f1/(beta+D k²) and f1=beta/(alpha+beta) exp[-Dk²/(2mu)](1+Dk²/beta)^(-alpha/(2mu)), establishing the normalized product characteristic function. Its symmetric LK density is [(a+1)e^-c|x|-e^-d|x|]/|x|>0 for every positive parameter, so all laws are infinitely divisible. Classical 1D class-L criterion asks monotonic h; h'(r)=-(a+1)c e^-cr+d e^-dr≤0 for all r iff (a+1)c≥d, equivalent β(4μ+α)≥4μ². At equality q=-h'≥0, symmetric compound-Poisson intensity 2a=α/μ, and Gaussian variance rate 2D/μ yield χ(k)=k(log φ)'; ordinary OU convolution recovers exact stationary marginal. Below boundary h increases near zero and no OU-Lévy stationary marginal can match. Equal-rate threshold is 2(sqrt2-1)μ. Independent exact symbolic derivative and positivity tests corroborate; the algebraic threshold is exact, not deduced from simulations.
